string.text: Mad Veteran

Rumor says some psycho showed up from the deep Zone. Mutters weird shit, wrapped in fat gear. Right in front of rookies he dropped a whole pack of brothers without breaking a sweat. Then cut down half those rookies with a single burst.

September 27: I did it! I finally did it! I saved up for gear I could only dream of half a year ago! A real exoskeleton — now I can haul a Zenit with my own hands! Unreal. And all it took was planting a mine in the right spot! Off those Duty guys I also took a scientists' field prototype, and the anonymous clients paid generously! Shame, of course — Duty helped me out a couple of times... But this is the Zone. Everyone survives however they can.

October 2: Went with the boys all the way to the Army Warehouses. Absolute slaughter. Scattered the trader cases into stashes, and even dropped that pseudogiant Sakharov ordered. The dead Duty guy's gun barely jams. Local bandits we just scared off with a burst; they worked us with SKS — fat lot of good, the kikimoras heard them and ate them. And then... Monochrome and mercs locked horns, and we got caught between them. Vaska covered our retreat; we got out. Rest in peace. Made a solid haul.

October 5. Went to the Garbage; Andrzej pulled coordinates of three caches from piled-up PDAs. Five of us went in; I came back alone. Shouldn't have blown up those Duty guys. They hired some psycho who started cracking us like nuts from the junk pile. Before we knew it, Andrzej and Grisha were down. Went down by the bus stop. Fat lot of good — the Zone is punishing me. A controller. We ran; the sniper dropped Kishka, and the controller fried Rostik's brains. I saw blood fountain from his ears. I stayed away from the controller — better die to a bullet — so I ran for the pile. Thought I was done, but the sniper opened up on me and couldn't penetrate. Took the risk, climbed the pile, took two to the chest plate — nothing. I snapped his neck. Hers, rather. A girl, still young. Dropped us with a Mosin; guess she had no AP rounds. Do those even exist for a Mosin? Took the controller from a good angle. Looted the boys, gathered the arts. They don't need them anymore. Off the girl's body I took a Golden Fish.

October 6. Should have buried the boys. And the girl. Wasn't Christian of me.

October 8. Got drunk. Hard without the boys, and nobody wants to visit the shelter. My reputation is trash.

November 25. Worked. Have to go alone, what else. Reputation keeps people away, but orders keep coming. I solve half the Zone's problems now. Sent my mother a grand.

November 26. Call from mom's phone. Died of a stroke. Fuck, the Zone is punishing me. Fuck it. I'll punish it myself. Heading north. I already know how to ride out super-emissions — in the labs. I'm not afraid of monsters anymore. The worst monster in the Zone is me.

December 3: Think I'm starting to understand how the Darkness works. Maybe there's a chance to end this nightmare. Heading for the NPP.

December 18. No chance. Barely remember how I survived, but the artefacts won't let me die. Came back to the old shelter. Cleaned out — whatever. I'm almost unkillable, but every stalker I see tries, poor idiots. Monochrome don't — they just stare through me like I'm not there. Mutants don't touch me either. Tried asking some controller — he told me to piss off. Fine. There's water in the shelter; I'll wash up like a human, grab the caches... Dunno. Give it to charity, get drunk, and end it.

December 18. The suit fused to the skin.

December 19. Two rookies came to the shelter today. Saw me and opened up with shotguns. The body reacted faster than I did. Tried to drop the gun — can't. Hard to write. Tried to eject the mag so I wouldn't shoot anyone else... Fired two hundred rounds at least. Ammo doesn't run out.

December 20. Whatever. Going south, maybe see the sun. Whoever can kill me — thank you. Last cache I remember — in the electrical panel at the elevator, on the Cordon. Hidden compartment. Take whatever's there, and leave. This is an endless cycle of violence. Live a quiet boring life while you still can. You've got a couple decades left. Enjoy them.
Veteran's diary
Unknown contact, heavy armor. Rally point — no fire without command.
Comrades, not a civilian. Alone but dangerous. Organized withdrawal!
That exo... Not ours. Not theirs. Move out before we engage.
Whoa, boys, that ain't a mark. We walk — let him talk to himself.
Hero shit's cancelled. Psycho with a MG ain't our client. We're gone!
Quiet... See the exo? Not a trader. Soft exit while we're whole.
Guys, above our pay grade. Fall back, pass the coords to the right people.
He's... broken. Don't touch. Clear Sky keeps its own — we leave.
Strange stalker in heavy armor. Observe from range, no approach.
Hell, run! Psycho in heavy armor — not worth it!
Dangerous contact. Fall back while we can.
Duty, fall back. Unknown target, heavy kit. No heroics without orders.
Contact: lone exo. Unstable behavior. Withdraw and report.
Not a bandit, not a merc. Too calm. Safe distance, now!
Guys, that's not freedom — that's a walking asylum. No heroics, we bounce.
He's staring through us... Bad vibes. Leave before he starts.
Cool suit, worse energy. Freedom also means knowing when to leave.
Brother... this is not our rite. Step aside. Another darkness lives in him.
He is already given to something. Do not interfere. Leave in silence.
Contract void. Target looks like a walking firebase. Distance is our friend.
Too quiet for a living man. Not dying for someone else's interest. Out.
Exo, MG, solo. Bad survival odds. Withdraw.
Shit, that ain't loot — that's death. Run before he opens up!
Don't poke it. One psycho, serious gun. Legs, now!
Shit, boys, run! Some psycho in an exo with empty eyes — leave him alone!
Hold up... That armored freak. Not a mutant, not Monolith. We fall back if we want to live.
Never seen that. Stands like a statue with a Zenit. Move before he notices!
Radio
Thank you, stalker. Maybe in death I will finally see... the Light.
Unknown
Fuck, this is insane! We dropped that psycho and he is empty! Gun sewn to his hands! Suit fused to the skin! How the hell did he reload? Screw it, we are leaving!
Stalker
